full_prompt_en: A square fantasy oil-style illustration shows an armored rider on a white horse charging through a deep forest, with another figure following behind. The background is a tangle of ancient dark trees, thick roots, mossy trunks, and small breaks of cool daylight. A massive twisted trunk arches across the upper center, making a shadowed gateway around the moving group. The white horse dominates the center-right, head raised and mane blown backward, its front legs lifted over low brush. Brown leather reins and a patterned saddle strap cross the bright coat. The front rider leans forward in pale gold armor and a flowing cloak, with long light hair flying behind the shoulders. A sword or long weapon extends diagonally toward the left, aligning with the group's rapid movement. At the mid-left, a second rider in a red cloak and darker clothing follows on a brown horse, partly screened by the trunk and leaves. Ferns, small white flowers, and sunlit grass gather across the lower edge, making the horses' path feel narrow and uneven. The faces are small but the posture and equipment are clear; no text or emblem is readable. Fine painted detail articulates armor, tack, hair, and leaves, while broader strokes deepen the woodland shadows. Light enters through openings above and at the right, touching the white horse and pale armor while the trailing figure remains darker. Cream, olive, dark brown, gold, and muted red organize the action. The overall composition drives a bright central surge through a dense, ancient green-black setting.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形幻想油画式插图描绘一名披甲骑者骑白马冲过幽深森林，另一个人物跟在后方。背景是古老深色树木、粗根、苔树干和少数冷日光裂口交织的区域。一根巨大扭曲树干横跨上方中央，在疾行的一群人周围形成阴影门廊。白马占据中央偏右，头抬起、鬃毛向后吹，前腿越过低矮灌丛。棕色皮缰和带纹鞍带横过明亮马身。前方骑者穿浅金甲、披飘动斗篷，浅色长发向肩后飞扬。一柄剑或长武器斜伸向左，与队伍的快速运动方向一致。左侧中部，第二名骑者穿红斗篷和更深的衣服，骑棕马跟随，部分被树干与叶片遮住。蕨类、细小白花和受光草丛聚在下缘，使马的道路显得狭窄不平。面容很小，但姿势与装备清楚；没有可读文字或徽记。细绘画笔触刻画甲衣、马具、头发和叶片，宽笔触加深林地阴影。光从上方和右侧开口进入，照亮白马与浅色甲，后方人物较暗。奶油色、橄榄绿、深棕、金和柔红组织动作。整体构图把明亮中央冲力推过密集、古老的绿黑环境。
style_prompt_en: The image has a detailed fantasy-painting finish, balancing carefully modeled focal forms with dense rough-textured surroundings. Cream and muted gold carry the brightest mass, set against deep olive, brown, and restrained red. Fine strokes define equipment-like highlights and small organic details, while broader broken marks make the background heavy and shadowed. Diagonal movement cuts through layered vertical and arching shapes, creating a readable path across crowded space. Filtered daylight catches the leading planes and leaves the rear layers in cool shade. Matte paint, small flecks of light, and uneven edges keep the scene tactile. The overall effect is adventurous, lush, and dynamically staged.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细致幻想绘画质感，仔细塑造的焦点形体与密集粗肌理周围区域取得平衡。奶油色和柔金承担最亮体量，立在深橄榄绿、棕和克制红色前。细笔触界定似装备的亮点与小型有机细节，较宽破碎笔画使背景厚重而阴暗。斜向运动穿过层叠竖向及拱形形状，在拥挤空间里建立可读通道。滤过的日光照亮前方平面，使后方层次留在冷影中。哑光颜料、小亮点和不齐边缘让场景可触。整体效果富冒险感、繁茂且动态布置鲜明。
theme_en: A white horse and armored rider charging through a deep forest
theme_zh: 白马与披甲骑者冲过幽深森林
name: Larry Elmore
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
